about.body1: Systems Engineering Student and Full Stack Developer focused on software architecture and scalable systems. Through complex practical projects, I have gained advanced experience in designing resilient microservices, SaaS infrastructures, and real-time applications.
about.body2: I combine my academic background in logic and systems design with modern technical mastery (MERN, Next.js, Docker, TypeScript). I stand out for my ability to tackle real engineering challenges, such as performance optimization, offline-first state management (PWA), and data visualization, always striving to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

billforge.title: BillForge
billforge.description: Headless SaaS billing infrastructure with subscription management and dashboard.
billforge.fullDescription: BillForge is a headless billing infrastructure designed for developers who need full control over their subscription logic. It acts as middleware between your app and Stripe, handling subscription lifecycle, dunning management, and multi-tenant billing. Includes an admin dashboard for metrics and customer management.
features: PDF Invoice Generation and Dunning management
Metrics Dashboard and RBAC access control

backplane.title: Backplane
backplane.description: Microservices architecture with resilience patterns and Chaos Engineering.
backplane.fullDescription: Production-ready microservices architecture demo showcasing advanced resilience patterns and Chaos Engineering. The system is orchestrated via Docker Compose and features a centralized API Gateway handling Rate Limiting and Circuit Breaker. Designed to demonstrate how to build robust distributed systems capable of withstanding intentionally injected failures.
features: Circuit Breaker & Rate Limiting in API Gateway

sensorflux.title: SensorFlux
sensorflux.description: High-performance IoT data ingestion pipeline with InfluxDB and visualization.
sensorflux.fullDescription: IoT data processing system designed to handle high concurrency of sensor readings. Uses the MQTT protocol for lightweight message transmission and stores time series in InfluxDB. Includes pre-configured Grafana dashboards to monitor temperature, humidity, and device metrics in real-time.

prontoclick.title: ProntoClick
prontoclick.description: Comprehensive delivery and marketplace platform with real-time chat and geolocation.
prontoclick.fullDescription: Full-Stack delivery and marketplace platform built with a modern and scalable architecture. This project demonstrates my ability to handle complex business logic, secure authentication, and real-time state management. It integrates a robust backend in NestJS with Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL database. The frontend in Next.js prioritizes speed and SEO. I implemented WebSockets for chat and geolocation, solving the challenge of instant communication between actors.

holoself.title: HoloSelf
holoself.description: Interactive 3D and Augmented Reality (AR) catalog for web product visualization.
holoself.fullDescription: Immersive application that takes e-commerce to the next level. This project highlights my ability to learn and implement emerging and complex technologies like WebXR and Three.js. It allows users to visualize products in 3D with high detail and project them into their real environment. The main challenge was optimizing 3D model performance to ensure a fluid experience even on mobile devices.

cyberretro.title: CyberRetro
cyberretro.description: Nostalgic landing page with Y2K/90s aesthetic and modern visual effects with pure CSS.
cyberretro.fullDescription: A trip to the past with the power of modern web technologies. This landing page captures the unique aesthetic of the 90s and 2000s (Y2K) using pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, without heavy dependencies. It features custom cursor trails, starfield backgrounds, interactive glitch effects, and a retro user interface, all optimized to run smoothly on current browsers and mobile devices.
features: Glitch and CRT effects purely in CSS

bubbleverse.title: BubbleVerse
bubbleverse.description: Interactive playground that turns the browser into a dynamic canvas of floating bubbles.
bubbleverse.fullDescription: Dynamic and experimental web canvas built with pure JavaScript. Allows users to create floating bubbles containing inspiring messages, toggle between day and night visual themes, and observe physical particle interactions. It is a project focused on creativity, efficient DOM manipulation, and creating fluid and relaxing animations.

aivio.title: Aivio AI Backend
aivio.description: AI backend platform with REST APIs and documentation section for developers.
aivio.fullDescription: Aivio is a backend platform oriented towards AI assistants that centralizes all business logic and API exposure. It includes a core of services in Node.js and Express to manage authentication, users, and conversation sessions, as well as integration with external AI models. In addition, it has its own documentation section where endpoints, data schemas, and request/response examples are explained, designed so that other developers can consume the API without friction. The project focuses on best practices in architecture, security, and folder structure.
features: REST API organized in layers (routes, controllers, and services)
Integration with AI models via OpenAI API
User and session persistence in MongoDB
Documentation section with endpoint descriptions and usage examples

obitdata.title: ObitData Dashboard
obitdata.description: Real-time dashboard for metric visualization with React + Vite + TypeScript.
obitdata.fullDescription: Professional dashboard for real-time data monitoring. Uses WebSockets for data streaming, D3.js for complex visualizations, and Zustand for global state management. Includes configurable alert system, dark/light mode, and responsive design.

pulseboard.title: PulseBoard PWA
pulseboard.description: Modern Progressive Web App (PWA) with offline capabilities and real-time updates.
pulseboard.fullDescription: Progressive Web App (PWA) designed to work offline and online. Implements Service Workers for advanced caching, push notifications, and background synchronization. The interface is mobile-first and uses Socket.io for instant updates.
